LANDER REWRITE
==============

A remake of Psygnosis' Lander (1999). This download does not include the game:
it plays from your own Lander CD, or an image of it.

HOW TO START
  1. Put your Lander disc image into the folder
     "Put your Lander disc image here":
       LANDER.cue + LANDER.bin   (with the music)
       LANDER.mds + LANDER.mdf   (Alcohol 120%, with the music)
       LANDER.iso                (no music: the soundtrack is CD audio,
                                  which an .iso cannot hold)
     If your image came in a .zip, unpack it first. Copying the files of the
     Lander CD into that folder works too (without the music).
  2. Double-click Lander.exe.

  The first start copies the game files from the image to
  %APPDATA%\LanderRewrite\data (about 680 MB, takes a minute). After that the
  game starts right away, and you may delete the image if you like. A newer
  version of this download finds those files again by itself.

  Don't have an image? Make one from your CD with a CD imaging program, as
  BIN/CUE so the music tracks are included.

  Windows may say it protected your PC because the program is not signed:
  click "More info", then "Run anyway".

SETTINGS
  Alt+Enter                full screen / window (--windowed starts in a window)
  Options -> Controls      keyboard, mouse or joystick, and the key editor
  --aspect 4:3             the original's shape in missions (the default is
                           your monitor's shape; menus and films are always 4:3)
  --render-height 960      sharper 3D (480 is the original's look)
  --skip-intro             no intro films
  (these go after the program in a shortcut's Target: ...\Lander.exe --skip-intro)

  Saved games and settings: %APPDATA%\LanderRewrite
  (SAVEGAME.DAT in the original's format, LANDER.CFG).
  To remove everything: delete this folder and %APPDATA%\LanderRewrite.
